physical_subject: How can growing a list be cheap when some appends copy every item?
relationship: Doubling capacity bounds total item copying by less than2n across n appends; including writes yields less than3n operations, although one append can cost linear time.
operation: Show filled and spare slots, copying at capacity doubling, an exact running cost, geometric blocks and the contrasting ninth and tenth append.
closest_prior: Earlier algorithm titles and geometric series explanation
substantive_difference: Amortized sequence cost versus individual operation cost is the learning goal; this is not search, sorting or infinite summation.
